title: Allow two selected tasks to move together
body:
Simulation case: judgment
Rules added, changed, and removed (give IDs or write none): Change RULE-SELECT-002. Add RULE-MOVE-002 and RULE-API-004. Remove none. These are SIMULATED PRODUCT RULES for the SIMULATED FEATURE REQUEST.
Old behavior: Move selected accepted exactly one task in To do. Two selected tasks kept the button disabled.
New behavior: Move selected accepts one or two distinct tasks. A new batch API moves two tasks together in one SQLite transaction. The one-task API contract remains in effect. A mixed invalid batch leaves both rows unchanged.
Tests added: [api/tests/test_batch_tasks_api.py](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/312da3e35e0d2653a33461b6934ab3461c019cdb/api/tests/test_batch_tasks_api.py) [web/tests/e2e/test_batch_moves.mjs](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/312da3e35e0d2653a33461b6934ab3461c019cdb/web/tests/e2e/test_batch_moves.mjs)
Tests removed: none
